description: FUNCTION LOCALE-TIME-FROM-SECONDS (ISO 15.54) - seconds past midnight in standard numeric time form (15.54.3 r1; the 7.3.17 range) formatted per the named locale's (else the current LC_TIME's) t_fmt (15.54.4 r2), a scaled argument carrying its fraction (Annex D.31.4.5's nanosecond note). LIVE (kb/Work PB64 T4): CobolLocale.TimeFromSeconds. Introduced 2014 per the catalog's provisional window (kb/Work R28 - WG4 CD 1.2 Annex D.2); below 2014 the D8 window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502).
citation: ISO §2023:15.54 LOCALE-TIME-FROM-SECONDS; Annex A.4.9 item 5; provisional 2014 edge
